object:dart.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a slim diagonal dart with a brown middle and pale metal point. The blue-gray patterned floor is background, not part of the object.
object:dart.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the dart as a small stackable weapon thrown by hand.
object:dart.modelBrief: Build a short straight dart with a narrow metal tip, brown grip, and dark tail. Preserve the major silhouette and palette at 32-pixel viewing size.

object:throwing star / shuriken.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a dark slate four-point throwing star with small notches and a dim center. The blue-gray patterned floor is background, not part of the object.
object:throwing star / shuriken.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the shuriken as a stackable metal projectile thrown by hand. Its visible name in this tile is throwing star; the atlas association alone does not make the appearance a second weapon.
object:throwing star / shuriken.modelBrief: Build a flat four-point metal star with sharp tips and a central recess. Preserve the major silhouette and palette at 32-pixel viewing size.

object:boomerang.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a thick ochre boomerang bent into an open V, with dark reddish tips. The blue-gray patterned floor is background, not part of the object.
object:boomerang.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the boomerang as a throwable boomerang weapon.
object:boomerang.modelBrief: Build a single broad curved wooden arm with angular bend and darker end caps. Preserve the major silhouette and palette at 32-pixel viewing size.

object:spear.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a long brown diagonal shaft ending in a dark blue-gray spearhead. The blue-gray patterned floor is background, not part of the object.
object:spear.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the spear as a one-handed spear usable in melee or as a projectile.
object:spear.modelBrief: Build a slender wooden shaft and a compact dark metal leaf point. Preserve the major silhouette and palette at 32-pixel viewing size.

object:runed spear / elven spear.modelBrief: Build a refined slim shaft with a longer polished dark point and restrained runic detail. Preserve the major silhouette and palette at 32-pixel viewing size.
